name: duopore-public-quote-minimum-order-scenario
description: See how a supplier's minimum order changes the units you must buy and what they cost.

interface.longDescription: See how a supplier's minimum order changes the units you must buy and what they cost. Enter demand, pack size, pack price and the minimum order. See the whole packs needed, total units, extra units and cost. Zero demand creates no planned order. The app works out your scenario; it does not place orders or check supplier terms.
defaultPrompt: How many packs must I buy to meet this minimum order?
Show the extra units and cost caused by this minimum order.

positive.prompt: Use Minimum Order Scenario with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"requestedUnits":60,"quotes":[{"id":"Q1","unitsPerPackage":25,"minimumPackages":4,"packagePrice":10,"orderFee":5}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts.
